Message:
“Why do you keep up
the Witch Hunt against children
who fail to become witches?!”

Breaking through the tension,
Mother’s voice rang out.

“What defines a human or witch
is all but trivial.
Look inside each of us—
surely we’re all the same.

That’s why this child and I
can coexist...
No... We will...!”

“She may not be a witch,
but that girl is still
our adorable little sister...!”

Sisters...
I feel the same...
I want to stay here
with all of you too...!

After that,
a thunderous explosion
rang out, and the house
became filled with
a cacophony of noise.
